_note: Top-10 golden strategies from the lab3 hunt (#6, bootstrap fair value, is added once its 21-day live data feed is ready). The original strategies are archived in live_original.json.

strategies.label: #1 ★ All 9 coins · Fair value, sell early
strategies.why: #1 of the 16 golden strategies. Same entries as the old all-coin fair value; sells at the bid once it reaches fair value. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$7,369 on 5,814 trades, t=6.71; older archive t=5.30.

strategies.label: #2 ★ All 9 coins · Edge-sized bets
strategies.why: #2 of the 16 golden strategies. Bets more when the model's edge is bigger (up to 5x). Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$8,474 on 5,537 trades, t=6.14; older archive t=4.21.

strategies.label: #3 ★ All 9 coins · Fresh move, lagging quote
strategies.why: #3 of the 16 golden strategies. Only right after a fresh spot move that Kalshi's quote hasn't followed yet. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$6,219 on 3,422 trades, t=5.74; older archive t=6.43.

strategies.label: #4 ★ All 9 coins · Recalibrated fair value
strategies.why: #4 of the 16 golden strategies. Model probabilities made slightly more confident (slope 1.1). Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$7,930 on 4,618 trades, t=5.67; older archive t=4.07.

strategies.label: #5 ★ All 9 coins · Momentum-aware fair value
strategies.why: #5 of the 16 golden strategies. Assumes a quarter of the last 1-minute move carries on. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$7,476 on 3,844 trades, t=5.33; older archive t=4.32.

strategies.label: #7 ★ DOGE · Momentum-aware fair value
strategies.why: #7 of the 16 golden strategies. DOGE only. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$2,416 on 540 trades, t=5.27; older archive t=3.79.

strategies.label: #8 ★ All 9 coins · Better volatility
strategies.why: #8 of the 16 golden strategies. Uses a fast-reacting weighted volatility. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$7,400 on 5,009 trades, t=5.22; older archive t=3.64.

strategies.label: #9 ★ DOGE · Fair value, sell early
strategies.why: #9 of the 16 golden strategies. DOGE only; sells early once the bid reaches fair value. Final exam (15 locked days, $10 a bet): +$2,294 on 781 trades, t=5.16; older archive t=4.38.

strategies.label: #10 ★ All 9 coins · Re-tuned fair value
